A tiny airship with billowing sails drifts toward the floating castle, dwarfed to a speck against its vast bulk.
A pair of distant dragons circle the highest spires, tiny silhouettes against the glowing amber sky.
Specks of tiny figures stand on a long sky-bridge, giving dizzying scale to the enormous structure.
A lone winged rider approaches the main gate, appearing no larger than a moth against the towering walls.
A flock of birds wheels far below the castle's foundations, mere dots against the cloud layer.
Tiny boats rock gently at a sky-dock jutting from the lower ramparts, miniature against the stonework.
A colorful hot-air balloon drifts lazily past a turret, its entire envelope smaller than one stone block.
Distant specks of people line the outer battlements, their torches glinting like fireflies along the parapet.
A small griffon-rider banks sharply near the eastern tower, barely visible against the castle's immense shadow.
A second sky-isle floats in the far distance, its own keep reduced to a tiny silhouette by perspective.
A trading galley with three masts sails beneath the castle underbelly, looking fragile as a toy boat.
Tiny pennants snap from hundreds of towers, each one smaller than a fingernail from this distance.
A messenger hawk circles the courtyard below, a mere dark comma against the pale flagstones.
A rope-and-pulley freight lift crawls up the castle wall, the gondola a tiny swinging box.
Several gliders launch from a high platform, their riders reduced to specks the moment they leave the ledge.
A waterfall pours from a reservoir garden high on the castle, its full drop taking seconds to trace.
Dozens of chimney-smoke trails rise from the castle town within the walls, thin as threads from below.
A sky-whale drifts past the northern face, and even its enormous bulk looks modest beside the castle.
Tiny lanterns sway along a suspension bridge connecting two outer towers, strings of glowing dots.
A patrol of five armored riders on wyverns sweeps the perimeter, each reduced to a dark flicker.
A child's kite, escaped from the courtyard, tumbles upward past arrow-slits, absurdly small against the masonry.
A cluster of fishing lines dangles from a lower ledge, their owners invisible specks leaning over the edge.
A distant thunder-galleon warship approaches with full sails, yet appears no larger than a playing card.
Swarms of tiny glowing sprites drift around the clock-tower face, each one a faint ember-sized spark.
A hermit's cottage perches on a rocky outcrop beside the castle gate, doll-house tiny against the wall.
